canonical_title: Nvidia discusses $250 billion financing guarantee for OpenAI Ohio data center
treatment: Treat as credible reporting about infrastructure financing talks, not a completed agreement. Reinclude only for a signed guarantee, finalized financing structure, confirmed project scope or location, construction milestone, government approval, or material cancellation/change.
known_facts: The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in advanced talks to provide roughly a $250 billion financing backstop connected to OpenAI's lease of a proposed 10-gigawatt data-center project in southern Ohio.
SoftBank's energy subsidiary is developing the project, whose total cost including chips could exceed $500 billion according to the report.
The proposed guarantee would help OpenAI obtain debt financing on better terms because OpenAI does not have an investment-grade credit rating.
The discussions are not a finalized financing agreement as of this report.
reinclude_only_if: Nvidia, OpenAI, SoftBank, a lender, or the U.S. government officially confirms a signed guarantee or financing package.
The project receives a material construction, power-allocation, permitting, location, cost, or completion-date update.
The talks collapse or the financing/project scope changes materially.
notes: Selected as a new high-signal infrastructure-financing report within the midday coverage window. The figures and structure are based on people familiar with the matter; no completed transaction has been announced.
